Game Overview

Boneless is a action game built around survive as a one-armed warrior in a harsh, alien-ridden world where ammo is scarce, strategy is key, and quick reflexes are a must. Upgrade your abilities and face relentless waves of enemies in this high-intensity, skill-testing adventure that will keep you constantly strategizing and moving.

How to Play

Each session of Boneless follows a consistent rhythm. Survive as a one-armed warrior in a harsh, alien-ridden world where ammo is scarce, strategy is key, and quick reflexes are a must. Upgrade your abilities and face relentless waves of enemies in this high-intensity, skill-testing adventure that will keep you constantly strategizing and moving.
